# LogScope Benchmark Results

This run targeted the Docker Compose local API container with a 1 vCPU and
512 MiB memory limit. One `docker stats` sample during the 100 MiB analysis
showed 47.89 MiB in use out of 512 MiB; this is a point sample, **not** peak
RSS. The 100 MiB run completed without an out-of-memory termination.

The single 100 MiB timing below is a completion-time measurement, not a
statistically meaningful p95 estimate.

Measured against a running HTTP server. Every timed response was checked against
ground truth counted independently while generating the files.

Environment: `{"python": "3.14.6", "platform": "Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0", "cpu_count": 4, "ram_bytes": 8320221184, "server_pids": [], "replica_count_configured": 1, "server_rss_processes_measured": 0, "dependency_versions": {"fastapi": "0.142.2", "uvicorn": "0.54.0", "httpx": "0.28.1", "anyio": "4.15.1"}, "latency_conditions": "warm loopback uploads, concurrency 1", "error_policy": "error_and_fatal", "service_cardinality": 10}`

| File | Bytes | Lines | Runs | p50 | p95 | Peak server RSS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| bench_1mb.log | 1,048,561 | 15,837 | 1 | 0.181s | 0.181s | unverified |
| bench_100mb.log | 104,857,561 | 1,582,426 | 1 | 21.990s | 21.990s | unverified |

Health p95 during largest upload: 50.7 ms (317 probes).
Overload probe: 0 accepted, 4 busy responses.
Concurrency-eight probe: 1 accepted, 7 busy, 2.39 accepted MiB/s.

Special workloads (exact expected response verified): bench_long_line.log (65,571 bytes), bench_cardinality.log (360,041 bytes).
